speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
title: You Are Good Enough to Teach
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Brother Gabriel W. Reid spoke about “You Are Good Enough to Teach”.

quotes.text: I realized later that I was not the only one trying to make sense of it because I saw a news headline that read, “New Sunday School Leaders Include Men Involved in Church Education and an NFL Player.”
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As I have reflected on the Savior, the Master Teacher, I have noticed a beautiful pattern. Often, as He invited someone to teach His gospel, He also gave them a promise.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In the Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ, the sons of Mosiah were still young when they went to teach the gospel to the Lamanites. Their past was marked by rebellion, yet their hearts had been changed through the Savior’s redeeming power. As they desired to teach their brethren, the Lord promised, “I will make an instrument of thee in my hands.”
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When asked which commandment was the greatest, the Savior taught, first, to love the Lord our God with all our heart, soul, and mind and, second, to love our neighbor as ourselves.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: My father joined the Church as a young man. My mother had limited formal education. But together they possessed something far more important: a deep and abiding faith in Jesus Christ. They loved the Lord with all their hearts, and because they loved Him, they loved us in a way that helped us love Him too.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We learned that the surest way to truly love those we taught was to deepen our love for the One we taught about. As our love for the Savior deepened, He taught us to see the missionaries as He sees them and to love them as He loves them.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When the resurrected Savior appeared to the people in the Americas, He did not begin by delivering a sermon to the multitude. He began by focusing on the individuals. He invited each person to come unto Him one by one so they could know for themselves that He was Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Christ-centered teaching is rooted in relationships. The inspired new Sunday schedule offers weekly opportunities to know and love those we teach, helping them come closer to the Savior and helping them deepen their conversion.
quotes.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quotes.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
